REVERSER
Print the lines of a file in reverse

Binary name: reverser
Language: C
Compilation: via Makefile, including re, clean and fclean rules
Authorized functions: open, read, write, close, malloc, free

EXAMPLE

~/B-CPE-100> ./reverser -h
USAGE
./reverser file

DESCRIPTION
-h display this help
file the file to reverse

The program must read the whole file given as argument.
Each line of the file must be printed in reverse order.
